summary: Iteration 41 — verified the customer pagination bug fix (skip/limit) end-to-end. Backend GET /api/customers correctly honours skip+limit and reports UNPAGINATED total. Frontend CustomersPage now sends explicit skip/limit, exposes page-size selector (25/50/100/200/500, default 50), shows 'Showing N–M of TOTAL customers' label, and renders a pagination footer (Prev / 'Page X of Y' / Next) only when total > pageSize. Prev disabled on page 1, Next disabled on last page; click flow advances/retreats pages; changing page size or any filter resets to page 1.
critical_code_review_comments: CustomersPage.js (262 lines) — clean. Pagination state, useEffect deps, and the filter-reset useEffect are all consistent. fetchCustomers correctly appends skip+limit on every call.
Minor: fetchCustomers swallows errors via bare `catch { toast.error(...) }` — losing the underlying error makes future debugging harder; logError(err) (already imported) would help.

Minor: useEffect on L59 depends on the unstable function-scoped fetchCustomers/fetchProjects/fetchBanks closures (not in deps); existing pattern in the codebase and behaviour is correct, but a future ESLint react-hooks/exhaustive-deps run will flag it.

Backend routes.py L189-193: when agreement_filter='upcoming_due', it fetches limit*2 then filters in-app and the `total` is set to len(filtered) — so total reflects the filtered+paginated subset rather than the true unpaginated count for that branch. Not in scope for this fix, but pagination math (Page X of Y) on the frontend would be slightly off if a user combines upcoming_due with paging — worth flagging.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all pagination assertions passed (count label, footer visibility, Prev/Next enable/disable, page advance/retreat, page-size change resets to page 1, search filter resets to page 1)

rca_of_the_issue: Bug: only the first 50 customers were visible on /customers because frontend fetchCustomers omitted skip+limit, and backend GET /api/customers defaulted to limit=50, silently truncating the list with no UI affordance to fetch more. Fix (verified): CustomersPage introduced page (0-based) + pageSize (default 50) state, sends skip=page*pageSize & limit=pageSize on every fetch, renders a pagination footer when total>pageSize with Prev/Next buttons that are disabled at boundaries, exposes a 25/50/100/200/500 page-size selector, and a dedicated useEffect resets page to 0 whenever any filter (search/projectFilter/statusFilter/agreementFilter/bankFilter) or pageSize changes — preventing the empty-page-after-narrowing failure mode. Verified end-to-end with 59 customers: page 1 shows 1–50, Next advances to 51–59 (Page 2 of 2, Next disabled), pageSize=25 yields Page 1 of 3, pageSize=100 hides footer, search filter resets to page 1.
